status.en: 5 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 55% fewer than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kigali and Kinshasa.
status.nb: 5 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 55 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kigali og Kinshasa.

summary.en: Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has seized positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with Congolese government forces. The United States has sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama and is moving to remove Rwanda and South Africa from the AGOA duty-free trade programme. An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has killed more than 5,300 people and a UK doctor contracted the disease while responding to the crisis. The Allied Democratic Forces have returned to Lubero, rescued 29 hostages and continue to spread fear, while IS-linked militants killed at least 33 civilians in a village attack. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Joseph Kabila leder nå en opprørskoalisjon som inkluderer M23-opprørerne, som har tatt posisjoner i Rugezi etter en ukes kamp med den kongolesiske regjeringshæren. USA har sanksjonert Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og deres militære bank Zigama, og er i ferd med å fjerne Rwanda og Sør-Afrika fra AGOA-programmet med tollfri handel. Et ebolautbrudd i Øst-DR Congo har drept mer enn 5 300 personer, og en britisk lege ble smittet med sykdommen mens han responderte på krisen. De allierte demokratiske styrkene har returnert til Lubero, reddet 29 gisler og fortsetter å spre frykt, mens IS-tilknyttede militante drepte minst 33 sivile i et landsbyangrep. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
